raw_text: orbit app:log servauto-app.nmbp currently returns validation_failed: app:log accepts only a URL or hostname. Use instance:log for app.instance selectors. This should just work, no https should be needed.

expectation: Bare registered proxy hostnames succeed for app:log even when the text equals a canonical app.instance selector; no https is required.

protection.rejected_example: app:log servauto-app.nmbp fails with validation_failed telling the operator to use instance:log because the host text matches a registered instance selector.
protection.accepted_example: app:log servauto-app.nmbp resolves the exact registered proxy domain and reads the application log without requiring an https URL, while instance:log remains the explicit instance-selector command.
